heading.title: Processes to Compel the Production of Things

article.title: Magistrate may direct search in his presence
article.content: Any Magistrate may direct a search to be made in his presence of any place for the search of which he is competent to issue a search-warrant.
article.html:
108Magistrate may direct search in his presence

Section 108 · Chapter VII · Miscellaneous

Any Magistrate may direct a search to be made in his presence of any place for the search of which he is competent to issue a search-warrant.
